# Test fixtures

Only synthetic or explicitly customer-authorised drawings may be added here, with written permission recorded in this file. Export-controlled, proprietary or customer-confidential drawings must never be committed. Unit and end-to-end tests generate their own drawings (`apps/api/tests/drawings.py`, `infra/scripts/smoke.py`).

The Phase 0 acceptance set (20–30 authorised drawings, 10+ untouched) lives outside the repository on the pilot VM.
